vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who works for a company
vocabulary.example: We have a new member of staff this week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person whose job is selling a company's products
vocabulary.example: I work here as a sales executive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that someone or something is good
vocabulary.example: Mr Socrates recommended her for the job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who is paid to work for a company
vocabulary.note_en: Employer = the person or company that pays.
vocabulary.example: She is one of his best employees.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to work next to someone as a partner
vocabulary.example: I'd like you to work alongside Rachel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having control of something or someone
vocabulary.example: Who is in charge of this project?

vocabulary.word: get on like a house on fire
vocabulary.meaning_en: to like each other and become friends very quickly
vocabulary.example: The two new interns get on like a house on fire.

vocabulary.meaning_en: difficult to deal with; uncomfortable
vocabulary.example: This is an awkward situation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: knowledge and skill you get from doing a job
vocabulary.example: She has lots of experience in sales.

vocabulary.meaning_en: abilities to do something well
vocabulary.example: We need your skills for this task.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of work that you must do
vocabulary.example: My first task is to check the stock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start the serious work
vocabulary.example: Let's get down to business.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the goods a company has ready to sell
vocabulary.example: Please check the stock before you order.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used before by someone else; not new
vocabulary.example: Second-hand products are cheaper but lower quality.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how good something is
vocabulary.example: We pride ourselves on quality products.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to keep telling someone what to do in a rude way
vocabulary.example: Don't let her boss you around.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to refuse to change your opinion when someone pushes you
vocabulary.example: She stood her ground in the meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a list of steps you will take to do something
vocabulary.example: Let's agree on a plan of action.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to accept and value someone's decision or feelings
vocabulary.example: Please respect my decision.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop discussing something and go to the next thing
vocabulary.example: Let's move on to the next point.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a strong feeling of interest and excitement
vocabulary.example: I like your enthusiasm.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the way colleagues work together
vocabulary.example: It's important to build a good working relationship.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be proud of something we do well
vocabulary.example: We pride ourselves on fast delivery.

fine_lines.title: employee vs employer
fine_lines.explanation_ar: employee هو الموظف الذي يعمل ويتقاضى راتبًا، و employer هو الشخص أو الشركة التي توظّفه وتدفع له. اللاحقة ee تدل على من يقع عليه الفعل، و er على من يقوم به.
fine_lines.explanation_en: An employee works and gets paid. An employer gives the job and pays. The ending -ee is the person who receives the action; -er is the person who does it.

examples.sentence: Tip Top Trading is a good employer.

fine_lines.title: work with vs work alongside
fine_lines.explanation_ar: work with عامة وتعني العمل مع شخص. work alongside تؤكد أن الشخصين متساويان يعملان جنبًا إلى جنب، دون أن يكون أحدهما رئيس الآخر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Work with is general. Work alongside stresses that two people work side by side as equals, with nobody in charge of the other.

examples.sentence: I work with a great team.

expressions.phrase: I understand you have lots of experience so I would like to use your skills to help with the task.
expressions.meaning_ar: أدرك أن لديك خبرة كبيرة، لذا أودّ الاستفادة من مهاراتك في هذه المهمة.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to give a new colleague a role by praising their experience.
expressions.example: I understand you have lots of experience, so I would like to use your skills to help with the report.

expressions.phrase: Together we can do this job really well.
expressions.meaning_ar: معًا يمكننا أن ننجز هذا العمل بشكل ممتاز.
expressions.example: Together we can do this job really well.

expressions.phrase: Let's discuss this so we can agree on a plan of action.
expressions.meaning_ar: لنناقش هذا الأمر حتى نتفق على خطة عمل.
expressions.meaning_en: Suggesting a discussion when you disagree.
expressions.example: Let's discuss this so we can agree on a plan of action.

expressions.phrase: Please respect my decision and let's move on.
expressions.meaning_ar: أرجو أن تحترم قراري، ولننتقل إلى نقطة أخرى.
expressions.meaning_en: Politely but firmly ending a disagreement.
expressions.example: I've thought about it carefully. Please respect my decision and let's move on.

expressions.phrase: Maybe we could help each other?
expressions.meaning_ar: ربما يمكننا أن نساعد بعضنا بعضًا؟
expressions.example: We are both new to this, so maybe we could help each other?

expressions.meaning_en: A soft way to disagree after a compliment.
expressions.example: I like your enthusiasm, but we need to check the costs first.

expressions.phrase: We pride ourselves on quality products.
expressions.meaning_en: Saying your company is proud of its quality.
expressions.example: We pride ourselves on quality products and fast service.

grammar.title: Suggestions with Let's… / Maybe we could…
grammar.explanation_ar: لاقتراح شيء بلطف نستخدم Let's + الفعل (لنفعل…)، أو Maybe we could + الفعل (ربما يمكننا…) وهي أكثر لطفًا.
grammar.explanation_en: To suggest something, use Let's + verb, or the softer Maybe we could + verb.
examples: Maybe we could help each other?

grammar.title: so to show a result
grammar.explanation_ar: تربط so بين سبب ونتيجة: I understand you have lots of experience, so I would like to use your skills. وتأتي so that/so بمعنى (لكي) أيضًا: Let's discuss this so we can agree.
grammar.explanation_en: 'so' joins a reason and a result: You have experience, so I'd like to use your skills. It can also mean 'in order to': Let's discuss this so we can agree.
examples: You have lots of experience, so I would like to use your skills.
Let's discuss this so we can agree on a plan.
The client wants lemons, so we will send lemons.

questions.question: Which phrase can you use to give a new colleague a role politely?
choices: You are new, so do what I say.
I understand you have lots of experience so I would like to use your skills.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه العبارة تمدح خبرة الزميل وتمنحه دورًا بلطف.
questions.explanation_en: This phrase praises the colleague's experience and gives them a role.

questions.question: Complete: 'Let's discuss this so we can agree on a ___ of action.'
questions.explanation_ar: العبارة الصحيحة: a plan of action (خطة عمل).
questions.explanation_en: The phrase is 'a plan of action'.

questions.question: 'Don't let her boss you around' means…
choices: don't let her keep telling you what to do
don't let her be your manager
questions.explanation_ar: boss someone around تعني أن يأمرك باستمرار بأسلوب غير لائق.
questions.explanation_en: It means to keep telling someone what to do in a rude way.

questions.question: The person who pays you to work is your ___.
questions.explanation_ar: employer هو صاحب العمل الذي يدفع الراتب.
questions.explanation_en: The employer is the one who pays.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Please respect my decision and let's move on.
Please respect my decision and let's moving on.
Please respecting my decision and let's move on.
Please respect my decision and let us to move on.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد let's يأتي الفعل في المصدر بدون to أو ing.
questions.explanation_en: After let's use the base verb.

questions.question: 'Get on like a house on fire' means…
questions.explanation_ar: هذا التعبير يعني التفاهم والانسجام بسرعة.
questions.explanation_en: It means to like each other very quickly.

questions.question: Anna 'stood her ground'. What did she do?
questions.explanation_ar: stand your ground تعني التمسك بالموقف.
questions.explanation_en: It means not changing your opinion when pushed.

questions.question: Complete: 'You have lots of experience, ___ I would like to use your skills.'
Which word means 'a piece of work you must do'?
questions.explanation_en: A task is a piece of work you must do.
